detail.longDescription: I am working on a 3D game in Panda3D and I am trying to implement shooting using the mouse. After clicking the left mouse button (M1), I determine the point in the scene that the player clicked on and create an object (projectile) that should travel from the player toward that point. The problem is that the projectile only travels horizontally and does not fly toward the object I clicked on. I want it to fly directly toward that object and stop when it hits it. Additionally, the projectile can only be fired at certain angles relative to the player. For example: the player can be in the air or on the ground, I click on an object in front of the player, I expect the projectile to fly exactly toward that object, instead, the projectile flies horizontally and ignores the height (Z axis). I am using Panda3D and the Bullet physics engine. Could the problem be caused by how I calculate the projectile direction from the player's position and the position where I clicked? Or could it be related to using Vec3 , Bullet physics, or the way I obtain the target position from the mouse? Here is my code: from direct.showbase.ShowBase import ShowBase from panda3d.core import CardMaker from panda3d.bullet import BulletWorld from panda3d.bullet import BulletSphereShape, BulletPlaneShape, BulletRigidBodyNode from panda3d.bullet import BulletCharacterControllerNode from panda3d.bullet import BulletCapsuleShape from panda3d.core import Point2, Point3, Vec3 from panda3d.core import BitMask32 class Hra(ShowBase): def __init__(self): super().__init__() self.disable_mouse() self.fyzika = BulletWorld() self.fyzika.set_gravity(0, 0, -9.81) self.postava() self.camera.reparent_to(self.hrac_fyzika_node) self.camera.set_pos(0, -30, 20) self.camera.look_at(self.hrac) podlaha = self.render.attach_new_node("podlaha") cm = CardMaker("vzhled_podlaha") cm.set_frame(-20,20,-20,20) plocha = podlaha.attach_new_node(cm.generate()) plocha.set_pos(0, 0, 0) plocha.set_color(0.3,0.7,0.7,1) plocha.setP(-90) tvar_podlahy = BulletPlaneShape((0,0,1),0) # smerovani gravitace a posun v jejim smeru podlaha_fyzika = BulletRigidBodyNode("podlaha") podlaha_fyzika.add_shape(tvar_podlahy) podlaha_node = podlaha.attach_new_node(podlaha_fyzika) podlaha_node.set_collide_mask(BitMask32.all_on()) self.rychlost_kulky = 80 self.fyzika.attach_rigid_body(podlaha_fyzika) self.klavesy = { "w": False, "s": False, "a": False, "d": False, "space": False } self.accept("w",self.zmena_stavu_klavesy,["w",True]) self.accept("s", self.zmena_stavu_klavesy, ["s", True]) self.accept("a", self.zmena_stavu_klavesy, ["a", True]) self.accept("d", self.zmena_stavu_klavesy, ["d", True]) self.accept("space",self.zmena_stavu_klavesy, ["space",True]) self.accept("w-up", self.zmena_stavu_klavesy, ["w", False]) self.accept("s-up", self.zmena_stavu_klavesy, ["s", False]) self.accept("a-up", self.zmena_stavu_klavesy, ["a", False]) self.accept("d-up", self.zmena_stavu_klavesy, ["d", False]) self.accept("space-up",self.zmena_stavu_klavesy, ["space",False]) self.accept("mouse1", self.vystrel) self.taskMgr.add(self.herni_smycka, "herni_smycka") def postava(self): fyzikalni_tvar = BulletCapsuleShape(0.5, 1.5, 2) self.hrac_fyzika = BulletCharacterControllerNode(fyzikalni_tvar,0.5,"hrac") self.hrac_fyzika_node = self.render.attach_new_node(self.hrac_fyzika) self.fyzika.attach_character(self.hrac_fyzika) self.hrac = self.loader.load_model("models/ralph") self.hrac.reparent_to(self.hrac_fyzika_node) self.hrac.set_pos(0, 0, -1.25) self.hrac.set_h(180) textura = self.loader.load_texture("models/ralph.jpg") self.hrac.set_texture(textura, 1) def herni_smycka(self, task): dt = globalClock.get_dt() x = 0 y = 0 z = 0 if self.klavesy["w"]: y += 5 if self.klavesy["s"]: y -= 5 if self.klavesy["a"]: x -= 5 if self.klavesy["d"]: x += 5 if self.klavesy["space"]: if self.hrac_fyzika.can_jump(): self.hrac_fyzika.do_jump() self.hrac_fyzika.set_linear_movement(Vec3(x,y,0),True) self.fyzika.do_physics(dt,10,1/180) # cas od posledniho snimku, pocet max podkroku ktere lze udelat, jak ty podkrucky maji byt dlouhe vse-> kvuli presnosti vypoctu kolize a pod. return task.cont def zmena_stavu_klavesy(self,klavesa,stav): self.klavesy[klavesa] = stav def zjisti_cil(self): if not self.mouseWatcherNode.hasMouse(): print("kurzor neni v okne") return None mys = self.mouseWatcherNode.getMouse() bod_2d = Point2(mys.getX(), mys.getY()) bod_3d_near = Point3() bod_3d_far = Point3() if not self.camLens.extrude(bod_2d,bod_3d_near,bod_3d_far): return None # zdali se prevod nepodaril skonci to pozice_near_bod_vuci_okoli = self.render.getRelativePoint(self.cam, bod_3d_near) pozice_far_bod_vuci_okoli = self.render.getRelativePoint(self.cam, bod_3d_far) zacatek = pozice_near_bod_vuci_okoli smer_strely = pozice_far_bod_vuci_okoli - pozice_near_bod_vuci_okoli smer_strely.normalize() # prevod na vektor vysledek = self.fyzika.rayTestClosest(zacatek, zacatek + smer_strely*1000) if vysledek.hasHit(): return [vysledek.getHitPos(),smer_strely] else:print("zadna prekazka nebyla protnuta") def vystrel(self): data = self.zjisti_cil() if data is None: print("cil je None") return cil, smer_strely = data start = self.hrac_fyzika_node.getPos(self.render) start += smer_strely * 0.1 tvar_kulky = BulletSphereShape(0.1) telo_kulky = BulletRigidBodyNode("kulka") telo_kulky.addShape(tvar_kulky) telo_kulky.setMass(1.0) kulka = self.render.attach_new_node(telo_kulky) kulka.set_pos(start) kulka.set_collide_mask(BitMask32.all_on()) self.fyzika.attach_rigid_body(telo_kulky) telo_kulky.setLinearVelocity(smer_strely * self.rychlost_kulky) model_kulky = self.loader.load_model("models/sphere.egg.pz") model_kulky.reparent_to(kulka) model_kulky.setScale(0.2) hra = Hra() hra.run() What are the most common reasons why a projectile in Panda3D might ignore the Z axis and travel horizontally instead of directly toward the clicked object?
